_comment: OPERATOR INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\VISTA\appsettings.Production.json and fill in the real values. Do NOT commit the filled-in file — it is listed in .gitignore. Set NTFS permissions so only the running Windows user account can read it (icacls). SslMode MUST remain 'Required' for production; downgrading it violates the OWASP DA Top 10 transport requirement.

MariaDb._comment_Host: Hostname or IP of the XAMPP/MariaDB 11.4.x central server on the LAN.
MariaDb._comment_Port: Default MariaDB port. Change only if the server is configured on a non-standard port.
MariaDb._comment_Database: Schema created by mariadb-init.sql. Default name used by INFRA-06: merchsys_central.
MariaDb._comment_User: Dedicated sync account created by mariadb-init.sql user provisioning block: merchsys_sync.
MariaDb._comment_Password: Replace this placeholder with the real password set in mariadb-init.sql. The loader treats the literal string below as absent.
MariaDb._comment_SslMode: Required — enforces TLS on the MariaDB connection. Do not change.
